q: Basics
Explain the synthesis + release of T3 + T4?
a:
Follicular cell produce Tg → into colloid

idiodide into follicular cell via Na/I symporter (trapping)

→ oxidation into iodine → bound to Thyrosyl residue of Tg ⇒ MIT + DIT

⇒ 2 DIT → T4

⇒DIT+MIT → T3

→ into vesicle → into follicular cell → lysomomal fusion → hydrolysis of Tg → T4, T3, DIT, MIT → T3+4 into circulation

q: Which one gets used by the periph. cell?

release calcitonin

Aka Parafollicular cells

  • brain maturation (myelination)

  • Incr. Energy

    • lipolysis, incr. TG-synth

q: What are hot + cold nodules and what do they tell you?

q: How can you treat non-toxic goiter?😵
a:
1. observation with US
  1. drugs
    • iodide → diffuse + young
    • Levothyroxine in nontoxic multinodular + diffuse (=suppressive therapy)
    • if become toxic multinodular → treat hyperthyroidism
  1. surgery: growth despite supressive therapy; obstructive symptoms
  1. Radioactive iodine treatment (131l)→ reduce size of massive goiter in eldery+non-indicated for surgery+reoccurence
  1. Iodide in pregnancy + 6-18y (preventive)
